photos.desc: Fossil of Lewesiceras peramplum - a pachydiscid ammonite. This specimen comes from Upper Turonian of Poland.

photos.file: Lewesiceras peramplum.jpg from the middle Turonian of Dortmund - Westphalia, Germany.jpg
photos.desc: big (65 cm) Lewesiceras peramplum, middle Turonian, Dortmund. Typical for L. peramplum are the robust and thick ribs on the inner whorls and the flat living chamber
